context: A documentary on the history of Christianity
purpose: Discuss religious history; teach キリスト教/聖書/魂/犠牲/移行/いったい/もはや/ふと

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日はキリスト教の歴史を学びます。
lines.en: Today we study the history of Christianity.
lines.style: measured teacher opening, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 聖書は、世界で最も読まれた本ですよね。
lines.en: The Bible is the most-read book in the world, right?
lines.style: engaged student noting a fact, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人は、魂の救いを求めてきたんですね。
lines.en: People have sought salvation of the soul.
lines.style: reflective teen musing, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、信仰のために犠牲を払う人もいました。
lines.en: Yes, some made sacrifices for their faith.
lines.style: teacher conveying gravity, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 時代と共に、信仰の形態も移行してきました。
lines.en: With the times, forms of faith shifted too.
lines.style: student noting change, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いったい、何が人々を支えたんでしょう。
lines.style: wondering teen asking earnestly, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 苦難の中でも、希望はもはや失われませんでした。
lines.en: Even in hardship, hope was no longer lost.
lines.style: teacher offering a moving thought, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ふと、自分の生き方を考えさせられます。
lines.en: It suddenly makes me reflect on my own life.
lines.style: pensive student turning inward, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
